messages:
sam: hitting inconsistent types when using async stream for tool-calls — sometimes yields raw str frames, sometimes parsed dicts. downstream mypy + code blow up.

sam: Minimal async repro:
```
async with RedwoodClient(api_key=...) as c:
    async for chunk in c.stream_tool_call(model=\"gptx-tool\", tool=\"extract_json\", input=prompt):
        print(type(chunk), chunk)
```

sam: expectation: every yield -> parsed dict with 'step' and 'payload' keys. observed: TypeError because got str occasionally.

alicia: is this only streaming? non-streaming call_tool returns dicts?

sam: correct — non-stream returns parsed objects always. streaming seems to split JSON at chunk boundaries.

mike: likely incremental parse bug. current impl tries json.loads per chunk; if server splits object across frames we get partial string yields.

mike: @sam can you paste first few raw yields you observed?

sam: pasted below — you can see an escaped/unterminated string then the rest in next yield:
```
"{\"step\": \"1\", \"payload\": "
{"step": "1", "payload": {"foo": "bar"}}
{"step": "2", "payload": {"x": 1}}
```

alicia: yep buffer boundary split. parser attempts per-chunk parse; we should buffer until a full JSON object is available.

marco: quick context: which py-sdk version? we had streaming changes in 0.8.2 -> 0.8.3.

sam: 0.8.3-rc1; regression after async flush hooks landed.

mike: proposed fix: internal incremental buffer for stream_tool_call — only yield parsed object after json.loads succeeds. expose raw bytes when debug flag enabled so users can inspect frame boundaries.

alicia: feature request: typed streaming API, e.g. stream_tool_call[T] that validates with pydantic and yields T, so mypy knows what to expect.

sam: +1 — current annotation AsyncIterator[dict] lies. typed wrapper would remove a lot of user-side workarounds.

mike: short-term workaround for users:
```
buf = ''
async for ch in client.stream_tool_call(...):
    if isinstance(ch, str):
        buf += ch
        try:
            obj = json.loads(buf)
            buf = ''
            handle(obj)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
    else:
        handle(ch)
```

sam: works but leaky. want SDK to handle buffering.

alicia: internal action items: [high] add incremental JSON buffering in streaming handler; [medium] add stream_tool_call[T] typed wrapper + pydantic helper; [low] debug/raw export option.

marco: also watch retry/reconnect flow — if reconnect re-emits partial frames or resets buffer at wrong time, parsing corrupts. add unit tests that split JSON across arbitrary byte boundaries and simulate reconnects.

mike: i'll take the buffering + tests. marco to validate reconnect semantics. alicia to draft typing API. sam will open GH issue with repro + logs + CI link.

ci-bot: https://ci.redwood/1234/streaming-toolcall-failure (flaky unit)

sam: rel note: temporary docs update to warn callers that stream_tool_call may yield partial frames until fix ships.

alicia: thanks — we'll aim to land bugfix + typed API in next minor release.
